meaning: The objective sums two squared, tolerance-normalised residuals: a pulse ratio against 1.03 (tol 0.30) and dICP against 10.23 (tol 1.50). obj < 2 is then read as "the target corner is reachable", which is the switch between "search failure, keep fitting" and "structural limit of model 6".

could_move.what: The tolerances 0.30 and 1.50 set the pass/fail threshold, not just relative weighting. Loosening either makes obj < 2 easier and flips the conclusion toward 'keep fitting'.
Targets 1.03 and 10.23 are hard-coded in the objective, so the verdict is tied to these two literals rather than to a patient target file.
Only these two summary numbers are constrained over the seven parameters; anything else the m5-vs-m6 comparison leans on is free to drift.
The structural claim rests on failing 'from many starts', so the number of starts and the sampling range matter as much as the objective form.

expectation: Unknown. The direction depends on whether any start reaches obj < 2, and the comment itself treats both outcomes as still open. I cannot tell from the context which happened.

check.why: This is the single search script itself, cheaper than a full re-fit, and it prints the best obj so you can see directly whether obj < 2 is reached.
